name: Intel Xeon 6980P specifications
notes: Intel ARK spec page. 128 cores / 256 threads, 2.0 GHz base, 3.2 GHz all-core turbo, 3.9 GHz max turbo, 504 MB cache, TDP 500 W, 6 UPI at 24 GT/s, 12 memory channels, DDR5-6400 and MRDIMM-8800, max memory 3 TB, FCLGA7529, scalability 2S, 96 PCIe 5.0 lanes, AMX present, lithography Intel 3, launch Q3'24, RCP $13,955. Bandwidth is not printed; 12 x DDR5-6400 = 614.4 GB/s theoretical per socket is derived, not a vendor bandwidth figure.
